acceptanceCriteria: A deterministic bounded partitioner assigns every current root package to exactly one shard; full-universe equality and disjointness are verified, and newly added packages cannot disappear.
Historical package-cost inputs are pinned, bounded and advisory; missing, stale or malformed estimates retain a complete deterministic fallback partition.
Actual hosted before/after wall time and per-shard skew are recorded on comparable content/tool profiles; no speedup is inferred from package-duration simulation alone.
Retain race/count/timeout behavior, required aggregate status, failures/cancellation and independent review; do not silently change the separately frozen AFP selective-execution profile.
